messages:
alex: rolled v2025.3 -> canary (50%). deploy-bot started post-deploy smoke. I'm seeing eu-west1 kv-synth p95 jump 210ms -> 720ms and ~0.7% 5xx. holding rollout to 100%. @maria @sre-ops can you take a look?

deploy-bot: deploy complete (canary 50%). postdeploy smoke started: kv / embed / chat probes. results outgoing to thread.
maria: repro'd in eu-west1, can confirm. kv warmup looks ok but prefix cache miss_rate jumped to ~0.22 (baseline ~0.03).
kevin: quick check: inference-proxy shows upstream resets around the same time. sample log: `2026-03-21T14:23:11Z inference-proxy ERROR upstream reset (trace=xyZ123)`
priya: do we want to roll back or pin? rolling back infra is heavy. i'd prefer pinning canary back to v2025.2 while we triage. we can keep current instances up for investigation.
alex: agree — pin canary to v2025.2 and enable fallback routing to the smaller variant in eu-west1 for hosted traffic. i'll update the release notes/changelog. priya, can you apply the pin?
maria: applying pin now — switching canary route to v2025.2 and scaling down new model pods in eu-west1. will post confirmation when done.
deploy-bot: pin applied to canary route -> v2025.2. queued postdeploy smoke re-run.
sre-ops: added a temporary quick synthetic that hits the kv-prefill path; monitoring p95 and 5xx for 15m. pager alert if 5xx > 1% in window.
deploy-bot: postdeploy re-run (15m window) eu-west1 kv-synth: p95=230ms, 5xx=0.12%. metrics trending back to baseline. holding full rollout until operational review tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
kevin: sounds good. initial hypothesis: cache warmup + autoscaler jitter when new variant got traffic. capture trace ids and sample logs for RCA (example trace=xyZ123).
alex: :thumbsup: thanks all. i'll update the release-notes doc with the pin decision and change the release window to note the hold. tagging product for visibility and follow-up RCA.
priya: noted — i'll also add a short blurb to the changelog and create a follow-up ticket for the synthetic coverage gaps we hit.
